normalised: from top {first} row from left {first} car

def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")
    
    if not car_patches or not road_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    top_edge = min(r.upper for r in road_patches)
    car_patches_on_top = [c for c in car_patches if c.lower <= top_edge]
    
    if not car_patches_on_top:
        return image_patch
    
    return car_patches_on_top
